head.viewerNote: Your role in this workspace reads work. A workspace Owner or Member approves, sends, and accepts it.

blocked.control: Your role in this workspace reads work. A workspace Owner or Member can do this.
blocked.approve: Your role in this workspace reads work. A workspace Owner or Member approves briefs and accepts work.
blocked.targets: oxagen could not read which agents can take work. Reload the page to try again.
blocked.noApprovedBrief: Approve the brief for the item's current revision before you send.
blocked.noSendKey: oxagen has no key for the next send yet. Reload the page to try again.
blocked.needsRepository: Name the repository in Edit brief before you approve the brief.

gate.closed: This send cannot be accepted now.
gate.order_closed: This send has ended. Accept takes the newest send.
gate.run_active: The run is still going. Accept waits until it ends.
gate.pr_closed: The pull request closed without merging.
gate.no_pull_request: The run opened no pull request. oxagen accepts work only through a pull request.
gate.no_head: oxagen has not read the pull request's head commit yet. Read the checks again.
gate.brief_out_of_date: The item changed after its brief was approved. Approve the new brief before you accept.
gate.checks_unknown: oxagen has not read the required checks on the head commit. Read the checks again.
gate.check_missing: A required check has not reported on the head commit.
gate.check_missingNamed: Required check {check} has not reported on the head commit.
gate.check_failed: A required check did not pass on the head commit.
gate.check_failedNamed: Required check {check} did not pass on the head commit.

failure.notFound: oxagen could not find this item or its send. Reload the page to see where it stands.
failure.stale: This item changed since you opened it. Reload the page and try again.
failure.staleHead: The pull request has a new head commit since you opened the page. Reload the page and review the new head.
failure.notAllowed: The item's state does not allow this now. Reload the page to see where it stands.
failure.personRequired: Only a signed-in person can take this action. An API key cannot.
failure.agentRun: An agent run cannot take this action. A person takes it from this page.
failure.roleRequired: Your role in this workspace does not allow this action. A workspace Owner or Member can take it.
failure.refused: oxagen refused this action with code {code}.
failure.invalid: oxagen could not accept what you entered. Check each field and try again.
failure.pendingApproval: This action waits for approval. The access request is {accessRequestId}.
failure.unavailable: oxagen did not answer ({code}). The page reads the item again, so check whether the change was recorded before you try again.

read.deniedBody: Your roles in this workspace do not let you read work items. An organization owner can grant the permission.
read.pendingBody: Your access request {request} waits for approval.
read.errorBody: oxagen could not read this work item. Nothing on it changed.

copy.label: Copy the {label}
copy.failed: Copy failed. Select the text instead.

triage.heading: Triage
triage.failedNote: The last attempt failed on {at}. The item stays New with no priority until a retry succeeds or a person sets the priority.
triage.minutes: {count, plural, one {# agent minute} other {# agent minutes}}
triage.unrecordedModel: a model it did not record
triage.override: {by} set the outcome to {outcome, select, triaged {triaged} needs_info {needs info} duplicate {duplicate} out_of_scope {out of scope} other {{outcome}}} on {at}. {reason}
triage.question: Question from triage
triage.questionNote: The question shows in oxagen only. oxagen writes nothing back to GitHub.
triage.duplicateUnknown: Triage suggests this item repeats another one. Confirm the duplicate to close this item, or keep the item separate.
triage.duplicateOf: Triage suggests this item repeats <link>{number}</link>. Confirm the duplicate to close this item, or keep the item separate.

answer.label: Answer
answer.hint: The answer is kept on this item. oxagen writes nothing back to GitHub.

brief.heading: Brief
brief.approvedLine: Revision {revision}. Approved by {by} on {at} for item revision {itemRevision}.
brief.draftLine: Revision {revision}. Saved by {by} on {at}. A person approves it before the item can be sent.
brief.triageLine: Triage drafted these criteria. They are saved when a person edits or approves the brief.
brief.noneTriaging: Triage drafts the brief once it suggests a priority.
brief.noneQuestion: Triage drafts the brief once its question is answered.
brief.noneHeld: Triage drafts the brief once a person decides to keep the item.
brief.noneClosed: This item closed before a brief was approved.
brief.noneYet: No brief yet. A person writes one before the item can be sent.
brief.noVerdict: oxagen marks no criterion met. A person reads each claim and accepts or returns the work.

delivery.heading: Delivery
delivery.notSent: Not sent yet. Send gives the approved brief to one agent on one runtime. The work item grants the agent no authority.
delivery.noAuthority: The work item adds no authority.
delivery.budgetHeld: The gateway holds the agent's budget before each model call when its version sets a ceiling.
delivery.budgetRecorded: oxagen records spend after the run. Nothing stops the run at a limit.
delivery.keyNote: The key names the brief revision and the send. A retry reuses it, so the runtime starts one run for it.

review.heading: Review
review.noPullRequest: The run opened no pull request. oxagen accepts work only through a pull request, so return the item with what the agent should open, or close it.
review.noRecordedPullRequest: The send's record names none of these pull requests yet, so Accept stays closed.
review.head: Head commit
review.requiredUnread: oxagen has not read which checks the base branch requires.
review.requiredNone: The base branch requires no check. Accept rests on a person's ticks for each criterion and names {head}.
review.optionalNote: Shown for reference. Acceptance ignores them.

why.failing: Required check {check} did not pass on {head}.
why.failingUnnamed: A required check did not pass on {head}.
why.missing: Required check {check} has not reported on {head}.
why.missingUnnamed: A required check has not reported on {head}.
why.unread: oxagen has not read the required checks on {head}. Read the checks again.
why.none_required: The base branch requires no check. Accept rests on your ticks for each criterion on {head}.
why.no_pull_request: The run ended with no pull request. Return the work or close the item.
why.pr_closed: The pull request closed without merging. The item is not done.

review.staleBody: The agent's evidence is from {earlier}. The head moved to {head}. Read each claim against the new head before you accept.
review.earlierNote: On {head}. They decide nothing on the new head.
review.staleAcceptance: An earlier acceptance of {head} by {by} on {at} no longer counts, because the head moved.
review.mergedFirstBody: The pull request merged on {at}. The item is done only once a person accepts it.
review.closedBody: A closed pull request is not done. Return the work to the agent, or close the item with a reason.
review.consequence: Accept records your acceptance of {head} and merges nothing. The item is done once the pull request merges. Return sends it back to the agent with your reason, as a new send.

cost.heading: Cost
cost.coverage: Cost known for {known} of {runs, plural, one {# run} other {# runs}}.

kinds.triage_recorded: Triage suggested {outcome, select, triaged {a priority and a brief} needs_info {a question} duplicate {a possible duplicate} out_of_scope {that the item is out of scope} other {a result}}.
kinds.stop_requested: {actor} asked the runtime to stop send {send}. {reason}
kinds.head_observed: The pull request head moved to {head}.
kinds.checks_required: oxagen read the required checks on {head}.
kinds.pr_closed: The pull request closed without merging.
kinds.closed: {actor} closed the item as {resolution, select, cancelled {cancelled} declined {declined} duplicate {a duplicate} other {{resolution}}}. {reason}

correct.title: Correct triage
correct.body: Each change is kept on {number}. Triage's suggestion stays in the history.
correct.failedBody: Triage failed on {number}. Your priority stands in its place.
correct.reasonHint: The reason is kept with the change.
correct.nothingChanged: Change the priority or the labels first.

keep.separateBody: {number} stays its own work item. Its brief then waits for a person to approve it.
keep.inScopeBody: {number} stays in scope. Its brief then waits for a person to approve it.
keep.reasonHint: The reason is kept on the item.

editBrief.title: Edit brief
editBrief.body: Each criterion keeps its key. Saving leaves a draft that a person approves before the item can be sent.
editBrief.emptyCriterion: Write the text of every criterion.

send.title: Send to an agent
send.body: The agent gets the approved brief first, then the item's text quoted as data. The work item grants the agent no authority.
send.none: No agent can take this item now.
send.unavailable: {count, plural, one {# agent cannot take it now} other {# agents cannot take it now}}

why.no_runtime: It has no runtime that can start a run.
why.no_host: Its runtime has no host that takes work orders.
why.host_outdated: {host} runs an older oxagen build that cannot take work orders. Update oxagen on that machine.
why.not_operator: You do not operate this agent. Its operator sends it work.
why.busy: It is working on {number}. An agent takes one work order at a time.
why.busyElsewhere: It is working on another item. An agent takes one work order at a time.
why.unknown: oxagen cannot send it work now.

send.budgetHeld: The gateway holds the agent's budget before each model call when its version sets a ceiling.
send.budgetRecorded: oxagen records spend after the run. Nothing stops the run at a limit.
send.keyNote: A retry reuses this key, so the runtime starts one run for it.

stop.cancelBody: oxagen withdraws send {send} now. No runtime has claimed it. If {runtime} claims it first, its run shows here.
stop.stopBody: {agent} stops at its next step. Its commits, its pull request, the brief, and the history stay. The page shows the run stopped once {runtime} confirms.
stop.withdrawBody: No run started for send {send}. Withdrawing ends the send now.
stop.after: The item goes back to Ready, or to Changed when the source changed after the brief was approved.
stop.reasonHint: The reason is kept on the send.

return.title: Return to {agent}
return.body: The agent gets your reason and the same brief, as send {send}.
return.reasonHint: The agent and everyone who opens the item read this.
return.noPullRequest: The agent opens a pull request this time.
return.merged: The pull request already merged, so the agent opens a new pull request for this return.
return.closed: The pull request is closed, so the agent opens a new one.
return.resendHint: Clear this box to keep the item in Ready.
return.resendRefused: The return stands, and oxagen did not send the item again. {reason} The item waits in Ready.

accept.title: Accept {number}
accept.tickEach: Tick each criterion you checked yourself on {head}.
accept.ticksOnly: No check is required here, so your ticks are the whole acceptance.
accept.doneOnAccept: The pull request already merged, so the item is done once you accept.
accept.doneOnMerge: The item is done once the pull request merges.
accept.newCommit: A new commit on the pull request voids this acceptance.

close.title: Close {number}
close.body: Closing keeps the item and its history. Reopen brings it back.
close.github: The GitHub issue stays open, because oxagen writes nothing back.
close.reasonHint: Everyone who opens the item reads this.

reopen.title: Reopen {number}
reopen.body: The earlier sends, review, and result stay in the history. The brief goes back to a draft, so a person approves it before the next send.
reopen.reasonHint: Everyone who opens the item reads this.
